user_intent: 二氧化碳浓度 应 低于 7%
期望 声音 处于 26 dB
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF mijia_CO2_ultra_sensor.get_CO2_concentration() > 7 AND aqara_human_sensor.reading() == 人在家 THEN turn_on() xiaomi_air_purifier
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() > 26 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN motor_control(2) babai_curtain
IF xiaomi_volume_sensor.reading() < 26 AND aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == true THEN motor_control(1) babai_curtain
IF aqara_motion_sensor.motion_state() == false THEN turn_off() xiaomi_air_purifier
